items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Carl Jefferson, who is Concord Records, calls and said, “I want you to do this, we’re going to do a record with a Brazilian piano player singer that I just signed... And I said, “Okay.” So he hired Cal’s — me

ctx.x: Yeah, right. It’d be nice if you got like a certificate or something.
Well you know Carl Jefferson from Concord Records gave us each plaques.
